product_family: Notion AI — AI-powered workspace features including Notion Agent, Custom Agents, AI Meeting Notes, Enterprise Search, and core AI capabilities for document generation, summarization, and task automation.

certifications.proof_quote: The SOC 2 Type 2 is an audit report performed by an independent third-party certified by the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants (AICPA)

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: ISO 27001 – Information Security Management System standard

certifications.name: ISO 27018
certifications.proof_quote: ISO 27018 – Privacy controls for cloud services

certifications.name: ISO 27701
certifications.proof_quote: ISO 27701 – Privacy Information Management System standard

certifications.name: BSI C5

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: To be eligible to sign Notion's BAA, you must subscribe to our Enterprise Plan. Notion AI enables HIPAA compliance by utilizing LLM provider's zero-retention APIs.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: PCI DSS – Payment Card Industry compliance (Merchant Level 2)

certifications.name: K-FSI

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: Notion provides a Data Processing Addendum (DPA) that applies when the company processes personal data subject to GDPR on behalf of customers. Uses standard contractual clauses (SCCs) for transfers.

privacy.ai_training_note: By default, Notion and its AI Subprocessors do not use Customer Data to train any models. Contractual agreements with AI subprocessors prohibit use of customer data for model training.
privacy.data_region: Multi-region; uses AWS infrastructure with SCCs for international transfers. Enterprise plans support zero-retention with LLM providers.

security.name: Data Retention (Enterprise)
security.value: Zero retention for LLM providers; no data stored with AI subprocessors

security.name: Data Retention (Non-Enterprise)
security.value: 30 days or fewer retention with LLM providers before deletion

security.name: Embeddings Retention
security.value: Deleted within 60 days of page or workspace deletion

security.name: Authentication
security.value: SAML SSO available for Enterprise; supports standard multi-factor authentication

security.name: Audit Logging
security.value: Comprehensive audit logging capabilities for Enterprise

security.name: Permissions & Access Control
security.value: Notion AI respects existing workspace permissions; granular database permissions available

security.name: Data Loss Prevention
security.value: DLP alerts available for Enterprise plans for sensitive content detection

security.name: Account Segregation
security.value: Individual customer accounts kept separate in production environment

security.name: Subprocessor Vetting
security.value: Third parties undergo security evaluations, attestation reviews, and annual monitoring

products.name: Notion AI
products.data_scope: Processes documents, pages, and workspace content
products.notes: Included in Plus, Business, and Enterprise plans. No training on customer data.

products.name: Notion Agent
products.data_scope: Performs automation across Notion databases and connected apps
products.notes: Available on Business and Enterprise plans. Can build, edit, and take action within Notion.

products.name: Custom Agents
products.notes: Enterprise feature. Can integrate with Slack, Google Drive, GitHub, and other apps.

products.name: AI Meeting Notes
products.notes: Business and Enterprise plan feature. Generates summaries and actionable items.

products.name: Enterprise Search
products.data_scope: Indexes and searches across Slack, Google Drive, GitHub, and other connected apps
products.notes: Business and Enterprise feature (in beta). Cross-app unified search.

compare.pricing_model: Per-member/month subscription (Free, Plus, Business, Enterprise); Notion AI available as trial in Free plan, included in Plus and above. Pay-as-you-go Notion Credits for AI usage.
compare.data_residency: AWS-hosted, multi-region. Enterprise can negotiate data residency. Supports GDPR SCCs for EU transfers.

flags: HIPAA compliance requires Enterprise plan subscription and execution of Business Associate Agreement (BAA) – not available on lower tiers.
Beta features (Enterprise Search) are explicitly excluded from BAA coverage and should not be used for PHI processing.
SOC 2 Type 2 and ISO certifications are verified via Trust Center downloads (https://trustcenter.notion.com/) – full audit reports not directly accessible via web.
Data retention for non-Enterprise plans is 30 days with LLM providers; Enterprise achieves zero-retention by using zero-retention APIs of LLM subprocessors.
Model-agnostic architecture allows switching between providers without losing context, but this capability may vary between plan tiers.
